caseNameFull: Warner, Secretary of the Navy v. Flemings

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 407 U. S. 919.] Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Michael Meltsner, Esquire, of New York, New York, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
